description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Mitotic Slime to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mitotic Slime, adding {B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the two Ooze tokens, adding {2}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Ooze tokens, adding {2}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate any of Kenrtih's other abilities.
